title: People’s Mañanera October 27
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**The Transformation Strengthens the IMSS and Its Workers  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum announced a 120-day action plan involving
almost 11.75 billion pesos (US$628.40 million) for an 8% pay raise for the
Mexican Social Security Institute’s (IMSS) 504,000 workers—the largest in 20
years—along with legalizing the employment status of 10,939 full time
employees and 2,500 medical specialists.

**Every Peso of the INE Belongs to the People and Must Be Accounted for
Transparently  
** “Everything must be made public; it must be transparent,” the President
stated as she demanded audits of the National Electoral Institute (INE),
without it being limited to the past year. Sheinbaum questioned why the INE
receives 22 billion pesos in non-election years (US$1.18 billion) and 35
billion pesos (US$1.61 billion) in election years, and called for
irregularities to be clarified.

**Open Dialogue, Without Privileges or Political Pressure  
** “The dialogue roundtable has been open for months,” Sheinbaum stated,
questioning the truck drivers of the National Chamber of Freight Cargo
(Canacar) blockading highways and its previous meeting with PRI president
Alejandro Moreno.

**Charlyn Corral, the Pride of Mexican Soccer  
** The President congratulated Charlyn Corral on winning the Ballon d’Or for
best forward, expressed her pleasure at the athlete’s recognition, and
highlighted her remarks on the growth of women’s soccer in Mexico.
